Moon Tower discusses the newly launched Monkey Nova, a venture acceleration and consulting arm helping early-stage teams with go-to-market, tokenomics, and distribution—the surprising insight being that the real opportunity isn't in vibe-coded apps themselves, but in turning them into actual scalable businesses.

topics.text: Monkey Nova is a venture acceleration partner and consulting arm offering go-to-market, tokenomics, business analysis, distribution, and growth support to early-stage Solana teams.
MonkeDAO's Monkey Foundry is an incubator for early-stage startups; Monkey Ventures is an investment syndicate; together they create a flywheel to support builders in the ecosystem.
Monkey Foundry demo day happening May 4th in Miami with early-stage teams pitching to investors for 5 minutes, with over 250 investors already signed up to attend.
Applications for Monkey Foundry pitching teams close next Tuesday with very limited spots available due to high volume.
MonkeDAO is the first NFT DAO on Solana from 2021, now a globally distributed community of 3,000+ members with local chapters across 20+ countries and 80+ different countries represented.
Breakout consumer products on Solana will be better iterations of existing web2 solutions optimized by blockchain, similar to how Uber improved taxis and Airbnb improved hotels.

KR2vumXfuLg.tldr: IXS Finance is an infrastructure platform for tokenizing real-world assets, founded by Julian Kwan in 2018. The company operates licenses in multiple jurisdictions and just opened in the US; the most striking element is their Bitcoin Real Yield product with BitGo, which lets Bitcoin holders borrow stablecoins at 0% interest (via structured collar loans) or 6% annualized to invest in tokenized private credit returning 6-15%, creating yield on idle Bitcoin without liquidating it.

topics.text: IXS was one of the first RWA platforms, starting in 2018 as a security token infrastructure for issuance, trading, and lending across real-world assets.
IXS just officially opened in the US last month to onboard US institutions after being licensed out of the Bahamas and operating globally.
Current TVL is $88 million, with historical focus on real estate but recent pivot to yield-bearing financial instruments like treasuries and money market funds.

Real asset tokens address the 'not your keys, not your coins' problem differently: if a thief steals your real estate token, the issuer will not redeem it for a stranger, making cybersecurity risk fundamentally different from crypto.
IXS operates as infrastructure with B2B partnerships powering the backend of four crypto exchanges serving 25 million users, plus LINE's 200 million users in Japan.
Bitcoin Real Yield product with BitGo: structured collar loans at 0% interest with 50% LTV and price floor/ceiling; or simple collateralized loans at 35% LTV with 6% annualized interest.
IXS token: 180 million fully distributed with ~10% held by team, ~10% by treasury, rest publicly traded; 20% of platform revenues flow to token buyback and burn.
Parent company Parent Code raised $8-9 million in equity from investors including Coinbase and UOB Bank Singapore; planning growth capital raise as US market opens.
Revenue model: percentage of AUM on Bitcoin product, revenue share with B2B partners (crypto exchanges, fintechs), advisory services, and SaaS fees for tokenization-only clients.
Major real estate asset coming to platform in near-term to significantly increase TVL; pipeline includes inquiries spanning commodities, startups, pre-IPO stocks, and shipping transport.

sZtaYOWQm44.tldr: Printr is a launchpad that lets anyone create tokens with instant liquidity, and founder Fed Online discusses Printr V2, which introduces "proof of belief" staking to realign incentives so traders hold longer than 10-20 seconds—the platform saw $25-30M volume in its first 24 hours with support from every major foundation and protocol, and plans a TGE with an airdrop soon.

topics.text: Fed's background: two years leading Printr after strategy consulting roles, previously led DeFi at Axel and was known as a crosschain expert.
Printr V1 launched October 2023 as an omnichain launchpad using Layer Zero for built-in token bridging, but failed to gain traction in the low-liquidity post-crash environment.
Pain point: traders hold for only 10-20 seconds because there's no incentive to hold; creators take little risk and most fees, misaligning incentives.
Proof of belief staking mechanic: gives a chunk of fees to stakers, incentivizing holding; 180-day stakers get a 3x multiplier on rewards.
Fee structure: Printr charges 0.4% flat on bonding curve and 0.2% post-curve—lowest in industry; creators can set custom fees that go to staking pools.
Early traction: belief token hit 6M market cap, $25-30M total volume in first 24 hours, putting Printr at number one or two market share among launchpads.
Crosschain arbitrage: tokens launched on multiple chains can be arbitraged by traders, keeping prices efficient across chains via Layer Zero bridges.
Platform optionality: creators can customize fee distribution, buybacks, staking, compound liquidity, starting market cap, graduation cap, liquidity profile, token supply, and pairing assets.
Funding: $4.5M raised total—$2.5M prelude closed November 2024 from founders and foundations, $2M Series A led by Bybit Ventures with 6 months runway remaining.
TGE timeline: Printr token launching soon with airdrop to points-program participants; token will list on leading centralized exchanges and have onchain liquidity.

1a_Q0DJoQRs.tldr: Titan is a Solana DEX aggregator and meta-router founded by Chris, a former hedge fund trader, that claims to beat Jupiter and other routers 80% of the time by using proprietary algorithms and on-chain execution. The most striking claim: Titan's Dart router executes trades on-chain at execution time rather than holding stale quotes, enabling it to beat Binance VIP9 pricing without requiring massive trading volume or net worth.

topics.text: Chris is CEO and co-founder, previously worked at hedge funds on US equities, then shifted to crypto in 2018 building custodial and trading systems, saw opportunity for a DEX aggregator on Solana in early 2024.

Titan's router wins more than 80% of the time versus competitors because other players use mathematically wrong approaches; the execution-to-quote gap problem exists because Solana blocks move every 400 milliseconds but quotes are held for 10 seconds.

Dart, Titan's on-chain router launched Monday, splits transactions across multiple pools at execution time rather than locking in a route, functioning like a true market order that finds best prices across available venues right when the trade executes.

Titan has integrated with more than 80 DEX protocols on Solana including Raydium, Meteora, Pump Swap, Marinade, Zerofi, Goonfied, and Bisonfi, functioning as a meta-aggregator that also pulls quotes from Jupiter, OKX, and 0x.

Argos is Titan's off-chain router that performs extremely well and handles complex mathematical analysis; on-chain Dart router executes the decisions at the last second, reducing quote-to-execution gap that creates slippage.

Solana's technical structure enables fast, low-cost transactions that attract market makers to quote directly on-chain, creating a self-reinforcing loop with retail traders and more liquidity; only Solana and Hyperliquid are credible for trading infrastructure.

Dart enables compliance with US securities regulation requiring best execution price guarantees; this feature could unlock regulatory approval for tokenized equities and RWAs on-chain, driving institutional adoption.

Titan currently operates on zero fees, prioritizing market share and mind share on Solana; future monetization models include payment for order flow similar to Robinhood and Citadel, plus specialized order types like limit orders and DCA.

qNtG-i40KV4.tldr: Stable is bringing mortgages on-chain to Solana, enabling homeowners to access equity as liquidity and earn yield through USDX, a mortgage-backed stablecoin. Founder Winston explains how the project turns real estate equity into tradeable assets and has already issued the first blockchain-native mortgage—a $114,000 loan on Solana.

topics.text: Stable turns real estate equity into liquidity by bringing the mortgage market on-chain, starting with US mortgages at origination through securities level.

Home equity accounts allow users to borrow against unused equity at loan-to-value ratios like 85%, with borrowed funds earning yield in strategies paying 10-15%, with spreads going back toward the mortgage.
First blockchain-native mortgage issued: a $114,000 loan funded through a home equity account, represented as an NFT on Solana tracking payments, penalties, and amortization.
USDX is a mortgage-backed stablecoin minted against these loans; holders become liquidity providers, and the yield comes from borrowers making interest payments on the underlying mortgages.

USDX security: if redemptions spike, Stable can use warehouse lines of credit from mortgage lenders to fund loans in dollars instead, then liquidate the underlying mortgages in the $13 trillion US mortgage-backed securities market with $300 billion daily trading volume.
Go-to-market shifting from direct consumer outreach to B2B distribution through mortgage brokers, banks, and wealth advisors by summer; existing brokers already onboard thousands of users monthly.
Security is the top priority: Winston aims to ensure homeowners are the last to absorb any losses because headline risk of 'grandma lost her house' would destroy the business and trigger lawsuits.
If USDX fails, it still gives ordinary people access to yields that banks monopolize, eventually letting communities set their own lending rates to neighbors.
